pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

2. D — Producers

3. B — Ice melting to water

4. D — 100 °C

5. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.

6. A — Glucose and oxygen

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

8. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

9. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.

11. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Health: Parasite control; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Structures in Animal production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aquaculture; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rearing Selected Animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
